info.name: Maw3idy API Documentation
info.description: Read a business's services and availability, and create or cancel bookings on its behalf.

item.name: Availability
item.description: When a service can be booked. Public, and throttled to 60 requests a minute.

query.description: The day to check, in the business's timezone. Today or later, and within the booking window. Must be a valid date in the format Y-m-d. Must be a date after or equal to 2026-09-18. Must be a date before or equal to 2026-10-18.
Limit the answer to one staff member. Omit to see every time anyone could take. Must match an existing stored value.

request.description:
Returns the start times a customer could actually take: inside the
staff's working hours, clear of existing bookings and their buffers,
clear of time off, and in the future. Each slot lists the staff who
could take it, so "anyone available" is one request, not one per person.

A slot can disappear between this call and a booking; creating a booking
answers `409` in that case.

response.body: {"message":"The date field is required.","errors":{"date":["The date field is required."]}}
response.name: A missing, malformed or out-of-window date, or a staff member who does not work here.

item.name: Bookings
item.description: Reading the diary and changing it. Needs a token with the matching ability.

query.description: Only appointments starting at or after this instant. Must be a valid date.
Only appointments starting at or before this instant. Must be a valid date. Must be a date after or equal to from.
Results per page, 1 to 100. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 100.

request.description: Needs the `bookings:read` ability. Paginated, oldest appointment first.

response.body: {"message":"This token is not allowed to do that."}

request.description:
Needs the `bookings:write` ability.

Omit `staff_id` to let the platform pick anyone who offers the service
and is free. The slot is verified again under a lock before the booking
is written, so two callers racing for the same time cannot both win: the
loser gets `409`.

The service's duration, buffer and price are copied onto the booking, so
later changes to the service never rewrite an existing appointment.

response.body: {"message":"The slot starting at 2026-10-05T07:00:00+00:00 is no longer available."}
response.name: The time was taken while the caller was deciding.

response.body: {"message":"The customer name field is required.","errors":{"customer_name":["The customer name field is required."]}}

request.description:
Needs the `bookings:write` ability. The appointment's time becomes
immediately bookable again and the customer is notified. Staff are not
held to the customer notice period.

response.name: Already cancelled, or in the past.

item.name: Services
item.description: What the business offers. Public, and throttled to 60 requests a minute.

request.description:
Only services that are active and have at least one active staff member
are listed: anything else could not be booked.

response.name: No such service, or it is not bookable.

item.name: Tokens
item.description: Getting and giving up API access.

variable.description: The business's subdomain. The token will only work here.

request.description:
Send a staff account's email and password and receive a bearer token.
Ask for `abilities` explicitly to be able to write; without them the
token can only read.

Throttled to five attempts a minute per caller and per email address.

response.body: {"message":"These credentials do not match our records.","errors":{"email":["These credentials do not match our records."]}}
response.name: Wrong credentials, or an account that belongs to another business.
